fieldName.description: The name of the overridden field.

modifiedFieldModifier.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link ValueModifier} for the field. Set to null if no modification is
made to the field's value modifier.

modifiedValueType.description:
Field to store the modification of the {@link ValueType} of the field. Set to null if no modification is
made to the field's value type.

modifiedStoredCalcIdentifier.description:
Field to store the modification of the stored calc identifier for the field. Set to null if no modification is
made to the field's stored calc identifier.

modifiedCalcExpression.description:
Field to store the modification of the calc expression for the field. Set to null if no modification is
made to the field's calc expression.

title: Type to structure the override information for fields.
name: BaseCustomizationAnalysis.Type.Overrides.Field
